title: Saita AI lafiya, sannan duba kowace amsa
course_title: Ilimin AI: Amfani da AI cikin hikima, amintacce da mahimmanci

say: Saita AI lafiya, sannan duba kowace amsa.
Wannan shine bidiyon don module 2 na Ilimin AI.
Ba kwa buƙatar kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka ko tsarin biyan kuɗi. Sigar kyauta ta ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude ko Copilot suna gudana akan wayarka.

say: Kammala waɗannan cak guda biyar kafin amfani da kowane kayan aikin AI don aiki na gaske.
Zazzagewa daga Google Play Store ko Apple App Store, daga ainihin mai haɓakawa. Aikace-aikacen AI na karya hanya ce ta gama gari don satar bayanai da kuɗi.
Yi amfani da dogon kalmar sirri na musamman kuma kunna tabbaci mai mataki biyu.
A cikin saituna, kashe horo akan taɗi inda kayan aiki ya ba shi damar. A cikin ChatGPT, wannan yana ƙarƙashin Gudanarwar Bayanai. Yi amfani da Taɗi na ɗan lokaci don aiki mai mahimmanci.
Kuma kar a taɓa manna ID, banki ko bayanan abokin ciniki.

say: Kada a taɓa manna BVN, NIN, lambobin banki ko katin kuɗi, kalmomin shiga ko lambobin lokaci ɗaya. Kada a taɓa liƙa lambobin waya, adireshi ko bayanan lafiyar wasu ba tare da izini ba.
Karkashin Dokar Kariyar Bayanai ta Najeriya 2023, kai ne ke da alhakin bayanan sirri na wasu.

AI na iya maimaita son rai na ɗan adam, don haka kada ku ƙyale shi kawai matsayi ko ƙi mutane.
